prompt:
I have an Excel file named "contest-entries.xlsx" with 500 rows of participant data. Each row has columns: "ID", "Name", "Email", "Entries" (number of raffle tickets), and "Status" (which can be "Eligible" or "Disqualified"). 

Please pick 3 random winners and 2 runner-ups from this file, ensuring:
- Only participants with Status "Eligible" are considered
- Selection must be weighted by the "Entries" column (more entries = higher chance)
- No duplicates allowed
- Show the full details (all columns) of winners and runner-ups in your output
- Display the selection timestamp and method (cryptographically random)

Save the winners and runner-ups to a file named 'winners.txt' in a clear format. The input Excel file must be named exactly "contest-entries.xlsx" and contain all columns as described, with 500 rows total (including header).

Make sure your output identifies winners and runner-ups separately and includes the selection method and timestamp.
